pause.note: The legacy detached CLI lacks an external graceful-stop control. Its verified checkpoint is retained; unsaved subsequent steps will be replayed on resume.

goal_update: Owner-requested run/UI/option integration and the original remaining Phase 3/4/5 work are now recorded in the active goal.

shared_trainer_adapter.data: Native overview/local tensors and source geometry can use the shared dataset and online-buffer collator without NaFlex encoding.
shared_trainer_adapter.model: Full and attention-linear LoRA protocols support forward, head growth and exact self-contained unmerged weight roundtrips. No SigLIP2 weights are used.
shared_trainer_adapter.verification: 150 focused CPU tests pass, with eight explicit GPU checks skipped in that invocation. A separate opt-in run passes all 12 FlashAttention tests, including six actual GPU FP16/BF16 dense and shifted/padded forward/backward comparisons and two actual GPU checkpointed encoder comparisons. Sixteen CPU common-loop full/LoRA stop/resume combinations cover histogram saving, rolling F1 and exposure tracking; final weights, metric slots and F1 traces match uninterrupted execution. Native schema default parity, configuration admission/refusal, self-contained LoRA reconstruction and owned OOD reservoir RNG continuation are covered. Compile and real-import checks pass without initializing CUDA. These checks do not establish complete option parity, live API/UI deployment or resumption of the existing comparison.

api_ui.implemented_on_branch: Architecture enum and six native fields match defaults, OpenAPI and request types. The shared configuration form exposes native canvases, view budget, feature width, pixel cap and seed. It clears cross-architecture encoder/head/pooling inputs, keeps shared training options, identifies external FlashAttention and distinguishes inference export from unmerged resume storage. Native schema admission rejects SigLIP2 pooling, repository initialization, blank frozen LoRA, invalid method/save mode/precision.
api_ui.frontend_static_review: Reviewed fetched-default initialization, architecture/full-LoRA switching, restoring SigLIP2 save mode, request spreading, pre-save error paths and existing A/B/C edit refusal. No frontend build/type-check run by the agent; owner-run results and actual browser checks remain pending.
api_ui.live_state: Main remains clean at 2b28c3b4. Backend health is OK, live defaults contain no native fields and live run catalog still has no FoveaTag comparison. Old detached process handles 56808/14676 are absent. Nothing is claimed deployed or resumed.

attention.owner_request: Support external FlashAttention, not only PyTorch SDPA flash kernels.
attention.implementation: The native shared factory maps use_flash_attention to external dense and packed-varlen kernels through the repository attention conduit. Packing separates shifted-window connected regions and preserves padding singleton attention. Shape/device plans are bounded-cached without per-step GPU-to-CPU mask synchronization.
attention.failure_policy: Explicit selection requires importable flash-attn. CPU/FP32/unsupported head dimensions use SDPA. External kernel failure is fatal. Disabled excludes external and PyTorch flash kernels.
attention.numerics: FP16 padding exposed an RMSNorm gradient NaN. Native optimized execution now uses FP32 normalization statistics; the frozen A/B/C eager runner remains unchanged.
attention.remaining: Actual native API/UI verification, end-to-end measurements and deployment remain pending.

replay.offline: Native sampling uses an owned per-epoch generator; views use source index, epoch and seed. Resume records completed source batches separately from mixed-loader events and restores exact scheduler/scaler plus latest RNG state.
replay.online: Source cursor and injection cadence are restored separately, including an injection pending at the stop boundary. Live network arrivals and prefetched online samples are not claimed to be bit-reproducible.
replay.gpu_pause: Both the comparison and native shared trainer wait for generation's GPU release before restoring state and retain coordinator acknowledgements.
replay.bundle: Native resume commits bind required state plus only optional artifacts generated under current settings. Disabled stale sidecars are not published or restored; native vocabulary/metrics/OOD save failures propagate. Candidates are verified in descending step order with coherent retained-bundle fallback and no implicit scratch restart.
replay.ood: Reservoir artifacts include capacity and their owned RNG in non-pickle JSON. Native restore validates state strictly; legacy files remain readable through the legacy non-strict path. Continued sampling matches uninterrupted sampling exactly.
replay.metrics: Native exact three-slot histogram/exposure runtime and rolling F1 buffer/threshold are stored separately from inference calibration. Epoch-boundary snapshots represent post-rotation state without changing the live accumulator. Native step checkpoints are published after periodic F1/threshold work, so step-file resume does not omit an evaluation. Histograms persist even when inference metric saving is disabled but rolling F1 or exposure tracking needs them. Unknown/masked entries are excluded from native histogram, rolling-F1 and validation confusion counts. One-source vocabulary rows are aligned; new/merged rows reset explicitly rather than invent joint observations.
replay.remaining: Finish online feature-specific and inference/export-path verification, the full option-coverage audit, live API/UI checks and deployment.

exports.resume: The primary safetensors checkpoint always retains complete unmerged weights; shared optimizer and training-state files remain alongside it.
exports.inference: LoRA runs additionally write name_export.safetensors and metadata in compact or merged form according to checkpoint_save_mode. Compact exports require a scratch backbone with the recorded frozen-tensor fingerprint. Merged exports are self-contained for weights, with vocabulary referenced separately.
exports.retention: Expired step bundles remove both export files; latest and best_f1 remain outside step retention.
exports.ui_requirement: Explain compact/merged inference export versus full unmerged resume storage and expose the export path; do not label the primary resume file compact or merged.

live_prediction.implemented_on_branch: The native shared trainer attaches a deterministic inference processor. The handle passes coordinate-aware views, checks the input pixel cap before decode, retains CUDA autocast precision and restores train/eval state on success or failure. It does not borrow SigLIP2 calibration or OOD feature-space references.
live_prediction.verification: Six synthetic CPU prediction tests cover full/LoRA, train/eval restoration, deterministic outputs, unchanged weights/RNG, foreign-assist exclusion, pre-decode cap refusal and failure cleanup. They do not establish live CUDA concurrency, checkpoint loading or API/UI deployment.

native_checkpoint_inference.implemented_on_branch: The historical inference load/predict endpoints recognize native metadata without downloading a processor or encoder. Self-contained full/LoRA and merged artifacts reconstruct strictly; compact exports require a fingerprint-matched scratch backbone. Native view/seed/cap/precision are mandatory, vocabulary indices must match the head, native metrics use the metadata's sibling vocabulary stem and OOD uses the native feature tap. Model-only best artifacts do not require optimizer state. Native ONNX/manager merge operations are refused explicitly.
native_checkpoint_inference.remaining: Publish fresh inference artifact paths to the training UI, verify CUDA/live prediction concurrency and complete API/UI deployment.
